d.title: One Piece: Umi no Heso no Daibouken-hen
d.en: One Piece: Adventure in the Ocean's Navel
d.jp: ワンピース ルフィ落下!秘境・海のヘソの大冒険
d.synopsis: The Straw Hats encounter a city in the middle of a whirlpool, called the Ocean's Navel, that is being destroyed by giant monsters. These monsters supposedly protect a treasure capable of granting wishes, but in the process of defeating these guardians, the crew ends up releasing another evil.  (aired after Episode 53)
